summary.text: Brenden Jones is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 46 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly identifies him as House Majority Leader and lists his occupation as small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Brenden Jones assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2017, succeeding Ken Waddell (D).
Ballotpedia reports that Jones began serving as State House Majority Leader in 2025.
The General Assembly lists Columbus and Robeson counties for District 46, a mailing address in Tabor City, and five terms in the House.
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled, and Jones advanced to the general election ballot.
